'''catman421 Sienar Fleet Systems (SFS) (V1)''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[catman421]]
* '''Published:''' 27 December 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Death Star II: Throne Room|DS2-D-deathstariithroneroom.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Death Star II: Throne Room
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTheed Death Star II Throne Room catman.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

This is a deck that i designed.  The only time i used it was against a hidden base deck, and i won by nealy 30 cards.

The published list has 58 cards.

== Strategy ==

This deck is designed to use Sienar Fleet Systems retreval and use TIE scouts deployed to asteroid fields to keep tossing them back into the deck.  I also can leave several TIEs out and beef them up with All Power to Weapons to make them a strong group.  This deck also has high-destiny characters to use with 3720 to 1.  I left the defensive shields open to change to different decks im up against.
